t: The Crafting Card is an item that can hold a recipe. It can be used for regular 3x3 recipes but also for more complex shapes. Various machines can use this card.$(br2)Note that stored recipes don't actually have to be valid. This card can also serve as a general way to represent 'inputs' and an 'output'
合成卡片是一种可以保存配方的物品。它可用于普通的 3x3 配方，也可用于更复杂的形状。多种机器都能使用这张卡。$(br2)注意，存储的配方实际上不一定非得有效。这张卡也可以作为表示“输入”和“输出”的通用方式。
